scope: Two self-closing, nonactivating native diagnostic runners use ordinary production Dart AOT and isolated Windows application metadata. One passive run and one read-only Computer Use accessibility-state control. No activation or input in the current user preview.
profileIsolationBasis: path_provider_windows2.3.0 derives support directory from CompanyName/ProductName
shared_preferences_windows2.4.1 stores its JSON in that directory
flutter_secure_storage_windows4.2.2 DPAPI JSON storage uses getApplicationSupportDirectory
No credentials entered or session imported
conclusions: IUIAutomationClientInfoSource identified the known read-only inspection client during the control run
The UI thread IMessageFilter did not receive callbacks despite known cross-process accessibility queries; it cannot identify this query route
A persistent UIA connection in this background control did not imply continued WM_GETOBJECT counter growth
limits: Foreground PID sampled only every5seconds; not continuous focus monitoring
Background controls do not reproduce sustained foreground CPU or identify the historical sender
WM_GETOBJECT timing covers object acquisition, not later accessibility attribute calls
No engine replacement, accessibility suppression, rendering-path change or whole-app performance improvement claimed
